policy: Exact conditional real-number consequences only. Each signature is copied from the corresponding new Lean declaration. Retained theorem dependencies are provenance-mapped and excluded from the new declaration count.
manuscript_anchor: Directed-rounding deep-tail enclosure; Accuracy-driven certification. The original concordance enclosure_arithmetic row explicitly omitted the positive-domain logarithm rule.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalLog
declarations.boundary: Real-valued formula; positive-value restrictions are explicit in theorems that require them.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalExp
declarations.claim: Positive real value represented by a base-ten logarithmic endpoint.
declarations.boundary: Exact exponential; no computable numerical approximation is supplied.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.logWidthRatio
declarations.signature: noncomputable def logWidthRatio (lower upper : ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.claim: Exact semantic counterpart of expm1(log(10) * (right - left)).
declarations.boundary: Defines exp(x)-1 over real numbers; it does not model the interval-library expm1 implementation.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.enclosed_log
declarations.claim: A positive-lower-endpoint enclosure yields a natural-log enclosure.
declarations.boundary: Requires lower > 0 and a true supplied enclosure. Lean totalizes log at zero and negative inputs, so global log monotonicity is not assumed.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.enclosed_decimalLog
declarations.claim: The same enclosure transports into base-ten logarithmic coordinates.
declarations.boundary: Uses log(10) > 0; endpoint arithmetic is exact.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalExp_pos
declarations.claim: Every finite real log endpoint corresponds to a strictly positive value.
declarations.boundary: No overflow, underflow, infinity or endpoint serialization is represented.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalExp_decimalLog
declarations.signature:
theorem decimalExp_decimalLog {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    decimalExp (decimalLog p) = p
declarations.claim: The positive probability value is recovered by the coordinate round trip.
declarations.boundary: Requires p > 0; this is an exact-real inverse identity, not a floating-point round-trip guarantee.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalLog_enclosure_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem decimalLog_enclosure_iff {p lower upper : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Enclosed (decimalLog p) lower upper ↔
      Enclosed p (decimalExp lower) (decimalExp upper)
declarations.claim: A log enclosure of p is equivalent to a positive-probability enclosure between the exponentiated endpoints.
declarations.boundary: Requires p > 0. The actual interval output still must enclose its true logarithm.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.decimalExp_ratio
declarations.signature:
theorem decimalExp_ratio (lower upper : ℝ) :
    decimalExp upper / decimalExp lower - 1 = logWidthRatio lower upper
declarations.claim: The endpoint ratio minus one equals the exponential of the log width minus one.
declarations.boundary: Exact base-ten endpoint semantics; no claim about rounding the width or exponential.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.logWidthRatio_budget_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem logWidthRatio_budget_iff {lower upper tolerance : ℝ} :
    MultiplicativeBudget (decimalExp lower) (decimalExp upper) tolerance ↔
      logWidthRatio lower upper ≤ tolerance
declarations.claim: The existing multiplicative budget is exactly equivalent to the log-width test.
declarations.boundary: Reuses the retained KomorebiQCOS.multiplicativeBudget_iff_ratio proof; the earlier real/rational acceptance theorem is not counted as new work.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.log_enclosure_relative_error
declarations.signature:
theorem log_enclosure_relative_error {p estimate lower upper tolerance : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (he : Enclosed (decimalLog p) lower upper)
    (hx : Enclosed estimate (decimalExp lower) (decimalExp upper))
    (hb : logWidthRatio lower upper ≤ tolerance) :
    |estimate - p| / p ≤ tolerance
declarations.claim: Every estimate inside an accepted positive enclosure has absolute relative error at most tolerance.
declarations.boundary: Requires both the true log enclosure and estimate enclosure plus the exact width bound; the underlying real relative-error theorem is reused.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.directed_log_acceptance
declarations.signature:
theorem directed_log_acceptance {p estimate lower upper ratioUpper toleranceLower tolerance : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (he : Enclosed (decimalLog p) lower upper)
    (hx : Enclosed estimate (decimalExp lower) (decimalExp upper))
    (hr : logWidthRatio lower upper ≤ ratioUpper)
    (ht : toleranceLower ≤ tolerance) (ha : ratioUpper ≤ toleranceLower) :
    |estimate - p| / p ≤ tolerance
declarations.claim: A valid directed upper width bound accepted against a valid directed lower tolerance bound implies the real relative-error contract.
declarations.boundary: Both directed enclosure premises are explicit. This does not verify mpmath.iv, Decimal, the parser, or endpoint conversion.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.logWidthRatio_nonneg
declarations.signature:
theorem logWidthRatio_nonneg {lower upper : ℝ} (h : lower ≤ upper) :
    0 ≤ logWidthRatio lower upper
declarations.claim: Ordered log endpoints have nonnegative ratio excess.
declarations.boundary: The endpoint order premise is explicit; arbitrary crossed endpoints are not treated as a valid enclosure.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.logWidthRatio_narrow
declarations.claim: Increasing the lower endpoint and decreasing the upper endpoint decreases the exact ratio excess.
declarations.boundary: Pure endpoint inequality. It does not establish that a refinement contains the true value or that the controller constructs such a refinement.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.logWidthRatio_narrow_accepts
declarations.signature:
theorem logWidthRatio_narrow_accepts {lower upper innerLower innerUpper tolerance : ℝ}
    (hl : lower ≤ innerLower) (hu : innerUpper ≤ upper)
    (hb : logWidthRatio lower upper ≤ tolerance) :
    logWidthRatio innerLower innerUpper ≤ tolerance
declarations.claim: A narrower log interval satisfies any tolerance satisfied by the outer log interval.
declarations.boundary: This certifies the width test only. Relative-error soundness additionally needs valid true-value and estimate enclosures.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.prefactor_log_enclosure
declarations.signature:
theorem prefactor_log_enclosure {s lower upper : ℝ}
    (h : Enclosed s lower upper) (hl : 0 < lower) (c : ℝ) :
    Enclosed (decimalLog (Real.exp c * s))
      ((c + Real.log lower) / Real.log 10)
      ((c + Real.log upper) / Real.log 10)
declarations.claim: A positive tilted-sum enclosure becomes a log-probability enclosure after multiplication by an exact exp(c).
declarations.boundary: Uses a supplied exact common log-prefactor c and a supplied positive sum enclosure.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.prefactor_interval_log_enclosure
declarations.signature:
theorem prefactor_interval_log_enclosure {s lower upper c cLower cUpper : ℝ}
    (hs : Enclosed s lower upper) (hl : 0 < lower)
    (hc : Enclosed c cLower cUpper) :
    Enclosed (decimalLog (Real.exp c * s))
      ((cLower + Real.log lower) / Real.log 10)
      ((cUpper + Real.log upper) / Real.log 10)
declarations.claim: An independently enclosed log-prefactor combines with the positive tilted-sum enclosure using its own lower and upper endpoints.
declarations.boundary: Both sum and log-prefactor enclosures are supplied. Analytic support/alias and omitted-mode bounds, CGF evaluation, and numerical outward rounding remain separate obligations.

declarations.name: KCosCertification.prefactor_log_width
declarations.signature:
theorem prefactor_log_width {lower upper : ℝ}
    (hl : 0 < lower) (hu : 0 < upper) (c : ℝ) :
    logWidthRatio (decimalLog (Real.exp c * lower))
      (decimalLog (Real.exp c * upper)) = upper / lower - 1
declarations.claim: A common exact exponential prefactor cancels from the multiplicative width.
declarations.boundary: Requires both endpoints positive; numerical widening of an interval-valued prefactor is not asserted to cancel.

not_proved: COS inversion, exponential tilting validity, support/alias estimates, or omitted-mode bounds.
Numerical spectrum inclusion or the supplied matrix-to-spectrum enclosure.
mpmath.iv or Decimal implementation, expm1/log rounding, decimal parsing, output serialization, or float conversion.
The engine positivity guard implies exact positivity; the formal theorems instead require exact positive lower bounds.
Actual controller refinement narrows valid enclosures, converges, terminates, or respects resource limits.
Displayed or rounded numerical estimates remain in the certified endpoint interval.
End-to-end formal correctness of the K-COS numerical engine.
